mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document (kb_id, title, content, type, parent_doc_id, creator_id, last_editor_id, created_at) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{parentDocId}, #{creatorId}, #{lastEditorId}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO document (title, content, type, kb_id, parent_doc_id, creator_id, last_editor_id, version, is_public, view_count, like_count, comment_count, audit_status, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{kbId}, #{parentDocId}, #{creatorId}, #{lastEditorId}, #{version}, #{isPublic}, #{viewCount}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{auditStatus}, #{deletedAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: update document set view_count = view_count + 1 where id = #{docId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, type, kb_id, parent_doc_id, creator_id, last_editor_id, created_at, deleted_at, updated_at FROM document WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deleted_at DESC

SELECT id, title, type, content, kb_id, parent_doc_id, creator_id, last_editor_id, version, is_public, view_count, like_count, comment_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM document WHERE id = #{noteId}
SELECT id, title, content, type, creator_id, created_at FROM document WHERE id = #{docId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: update document set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = #{docId}
update document set like_count = like_count - 1 where id = #{docId}
